description: Returns the full SVG source of multiple Glyfiq icons in a single call. Accepts 1 to 20 exact icon names returned by search_icons. Free icons work without a key. Premium icons require a configured server license key (connector URL or headers) or a valid license_key parameter. Each icon is reported individually as ok, premium_locked, or not_found; successful icons include their SVG. Prefer this over repeated get_icon_svg calls when inserting several icons.

license_key.description: Required only for PRO icons. Usually set once in the connector URL instead.

names.description: Exact icon names as returned by search_icons (1 to 20)

name: get_icons_svg
title: Get multiple icon SVGs
